title: CAD Knowledge Graph (Product Structure)
$comment: Backend-agnostic knowledge graph describing product structure + requirements (NOT modeling steps). STRUCTURAL COMPLETENESS INVARIANT: Every component of type 'bearing', 'shaft', or 'fastener' MUST participate in at least one connection_requirement. Connection_requirements describe abstract required connections (WHAT + WHY). Agent 1 outputs components, connection_requirements, dimensions, standard_parts, and shape semantics. Downstream agents validate and implement geometry/assembly.

schema_version.description: Version of the KG payload schema (not the JSON Schema draft).

units.description: Optional global unit conventions for numeric values.

length.description: Length unit for distances and dimensions.

components.description: List of components/parts/subassemblies in the product structure.

subassemblies.description: Named mechanical binding units representing physically bound groups of components. A subassembly represents a real mechanical binding (clamping, fastening, cartridge, module), not a purely organizational grouping. CRITICAL: If multiple components are bound together by plates, frames, or fasteners, a subassembly MUST be created to represent this semantic grouping. Subassemblies are strongly recommended but not mandatory for all products.

component_hierarchy.description: Optional explicit parent-child hierarchy for grouped assemblies (e.g., wheel parent and its child parts).

connection_requirements.description: Abstract required connections between components (Agent 1 output). Specifies WHAT must connect and WHY, with optional constraints. Relation types (HOW) are derived by downstream agents. Each requirement must include: id, between (array of 2+ component IDs), and purpose (semantic reason).

relations.description: Concrete relations with specific mechanical types (Agent 2/Agent 4 output). Each relation specifies a mechanical connection between two components with a specific type (fixed_to, rotates_about, supported_by, etc.). Each relation must include: id, type, a (endpoint 1), b (endpoint 2).

patterns.description: Optional: Symmetries, repetitions, and regularities (e.g., rotational_symmetry with count=3).

design_intents.description: Optional: High-level design constraints, behaviors, and intents (NOT geometry, but engineering purpose).

root_component_id.description: Optional id of the top-level component (assembly root).

intent.description: Optional high-level intent or use case (e.g., '濡ゅ吋顫弨鈧悥顒佹簚閸ｃ劋姹?). Used by planner to infer object class (robot/furniture/aircraft).

metadata.description: Optional human/system metadata; ignored by planners unless they opt in.

frozen_checksum.description: Hash of frozen content (format not enforced).

id.description: Stable identifier used to reference nodes across the KG (planner-friendly).

reference_frame.$comment: A local right-handed frame for the component. Keep this backend-agnostic.

parameter_value.$comment: Parameters are intentionally simple so planners can reason over them.

oneOf.description: Plain numeric value in the KG's declared units.
Numeric value with explicit unit override.

unit.description: Unit label for this value (e.g., mm, in, deg).

parameters.$comment: Use stable, semantic names so planning agents can map intents to parameters.

dimensions.description: Authoritative, immutable dimensional parameters inferred by Agent1.

derived_from_component.description: Optional component id used as the derivation source.

rule_id.description: Optional rule identifier for derived dimensions.

usable_for_standard_part_selection.description: Whether this dimension may be used for standard part selection.

dimension_sources.description: Map of dimension name to provenance metadata.

shape_semantics.description: Abstract shape description (no coordinates, no CAD steps).

type.description: Shape class (e.g., cylindrical, prismatic, plate, complex).

interface_ref.description: Reference to a semantic interface on a component (NOT a CAD face object).

interface_id.description: Named interface/surface/feature identifier within the component's semantics.

part_class.description: Mandatory high-level bucket for standard-part pipeline routing.

dimensions.description: Optional: resolved dimensional facts for the selected standard part (e.g., bearing d/D/B).

applied_to.description: Connection or subassembly ids this standard part applies to.

fastener_instance.description: One fastener/auxiliary instance in a fastener bundle (semantic only; may be modeled as placeholder geometry).

fastener_pattern.description: Semantic pattern definition for a fastener bundle (no coordinates).

component.description: A component node representing a part or subassembly. PURELY SEMANTIC: contains no coordinates, frames, axes, or geometric placement.

kind.description: Hard contract: 'assembly_node' is hierarchy-only (no geometry output); 'part' is a real geometric part (may be simplified).

must_model.description: Hard contract: only components with kind='part' and must_model=true are eligible for downstream geometry output (Agent2/3).

part_kind.description: Contract-level part category used by downstream closure and assembly reasoning.

modeling_policy.description: Modeling policy frozen by Agent1. Bearings should use simplified_model; hierarchy containers use container_only.

role.description: Optional functional role of this component in the assembly (e.g., 'load_bearing', 'rotating_interface', 'fixation', 'spacing', 'alignment', 'structural').

is_container.description: Optional flag indicating this component is a container/assembly that organizes child components. Containers may have minimal dimensions (only anchor points). Default: false for leaf components, true for assembly-type components.

is_modeling_unit.description: Optional flag indicating this component is a geometric modeling unit whose dimensions must be complete and derivable. Only is_modeling_unit=true components must have non-empty dimensions. Default: true for leaf components, false for pure organizational containers.

position_parent.description: Optional reference to parent component for hierarchical positioning. Indicates this component's position is relative to or dependent on position_parent.

role_in_parent.description: Optional semantic role of this child inside its parent assembly (e.g., rim/tire/hub/axle).

is_container_only.description: Optional flag indicating this component is used as assembly container/reference and should not be modeled directly.

has_geometry.description: Optional explicit geometry flag. false means this node has no usable geometric host surface and must be excluded from geometric host selection.

position_offset.description: Optional semantic positioning hint relative to position_parent (e.g., 'at_end', 'centered', 'offset_by_length').

description.description: Semantic description of position relative to parent (e.g., 'mounted at end of arm', 'centered on hub')

along_axis.description: Optional reference to component dimension axis (e.g., 'length', 'diameter', 'width')

fastener_instances.description: Optional: Structured contents of a fastener bundle (bolt/nut/washer/etc) with quantities.

parent_id.description: Optional parent component id for product structure nesting.

instanced_from.description: Optional prototype component id for repeated instance modeling.

definition_id.description: Optional geometric definition id. Multiple instances may share one definition_id.

instance_id.description: Optional instance identity id for assembly occurrence mapping.

interfaces.description: Optional list of semantic interfaces available for relations. Purely semantic: identifies functional touchpoints, NOT geometry.

interface_id.description: Stable semantic name for a functional interface/touchpoint on this component (e.g., 'mount_face', 'rotation_axis', 'contact_surface').

description.description: Optional human-readable explanation of this interface's purpose (semantic only, no coordinates).

subassembly.description: A named grouping of related components (semantic assembly hierarchy).

component_ids.description: List of component ids that form this subassembly.

role.description: Optional functional role of this subassembly.

pattern.description: A symmetry or repetition of already-connected components. Patterns describe organizational structure only and MUST NOT define placement or structural relationships on their own.

count.description: Number of repeated instances (e.g., 3 for tri-fold rotational symmetry).

component_ids.description: Component ids participating in this pattern.

applies_to.description: Optional semantic target of the pattern.

prototype.description: Optional prototype component id used for instance reuse.

instances.description: Optional ordered instance ids for this pattern.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the pattern (organizational meaning only).

design_intent.description: High-level design constraint, behavior, or intent (engineering purpose, NOT geometry or mechanical facts). CRITICAL: design_intents MUST NOT restate relations or describe mechanical facts. Examples of FORBIDDEN design_intents: 'wheel rotates about axle', 'arm is fixed to hub' 閳?these MUST be relations instead. design_intents may only express: purpose, requirement, constraint, or rationale (e.g., 'minimize weight', 'ensure smooth rotation', 'maintain 120-degree symmetry').

description.description: Semantic explanation of the design intent (purpose/requirement/constraint/rationale only, NOT mechanical facts).

component_ids.description: Optional component ids involved in this intent.

connection_requirement.description: Abstract required connection between components (AGENT 1 OUTPUT). Specifies WHAT must be connected and WHY, but NOT the specific relation type (HOW). Relation type determination is Agent 2's responsibility. Each connection_requirement includes: id (requirement identifier), between (array of 2+ component IDs that must be connected), purpose (semantic reason like 'rotation', 'load_support', 'fixation', 'spacing', 'alignment'), and roles (semantic roles derived from purpose). NO 'type' field閳ユ敄his is intentional; the specific relation type will be determined downstream.

between.description: Array of 2 or more component IDs that must be mechanically connected per this requirement.

purpose.description: Semantic description of WHY these components must connect (e.g., 'rotation', 'load_support', 'structural_fixation', 'spacing', 'alignment', 'fastening_mechanism'). Use semantic language, NOT relation type names.

roles.description: Semantic roles derived from purpose (e.g., mounting, rotation, support, fixation, torque_transfer).

constraint_intent.description: Downstream-facing abstract mate intent, frozen by Agent1.

mating_features.description: Abstract mating feature hints for downstream interface/marker synthesis.

constraints.description: Optional mechanical constraints for this connection (semantic level, no coordinates). Examples: coaxial_required, must_rotate, concentric_required, axial_preload, gap specification, etc.

description.description: Optional detailed explanation of this requirement.

confidence.description: Optional confidence score for inferred connection_requirements.

relation.description: Concrete mechanical relation between two components (Agent 2/Agent 4 output). Each relation specifies exactly two endpoints with a specific attachment type (fixed_to, rotates_about, supported_by, etc.). Endpoints are identified by component_id and interface_id for precise semantic alignment.

type.description: Mechanical relation type (e.g., 'fixed_to', 'rotates_about', 'supported_by'). Derived by Agent 2/4 from connection_requirement.purpose through engineering analysis. Agent 1 does NOT decide relation types.

interface_id.description: Named interface on component A where the relation attaches. Interface naming is defined/generated by Agent 2/Agent 4 (NOT Agent 1).
Named interface on component B where the relation attaches. Interface naming is defined/generated by Agent 2/Agent 4 (NOT Agent 1).

connection_anchor.description: Abstract semantic anchor for a connection contract. No coordinates are allowed.

connection_semantics_contract.description: Frozen semantic contract for how a required connection must be realized. This remains abstract (no coordinates), but it MUST be specific enough that downstream agents can execute it without inventing a different mechanism or anchor interpretation.

relation_type.description: Abstract attachment semantics such as support_member_distal_attachment, axial_face_perimeter_mount, radial_member_proximal_mount, shaft_axis_to_bore, bonded_tread_wrap.

reference_interface_hint.description: Frozen interface hint on the reference component, such as axial_end_face_max, radial_outer_face, bore_axis, distal_mount_face.

moving_interface_hint.description: Frozen interface hint on the moving or attached component.

assembly_reference_interface_hint.description: Optional assembly-specific interface hint for the reference component when feature-generation and assembly mating must use different interfaces.

assembly_moving_interface_hint.description: Optional assembly-specific interface hint for the moving component when feature-generation and assembly mating must use different interfaces.

orientation_policy.description: Abstract orientation rule, e.g. preserve, inherit_reference_yaw, radial_from_reference_center, coaxial_align.

rationale.description: Why this mechanism and anchor pairing is mechanically correct.

connection_geometric_semantics.description: Mechanism-specific geometric execution semantics. This complements natural connection intent with enough detail that downstream agents can execute the same mechanism without inventing a different mounting style or hole pattern.
